description.p: Riff is a Spotify client that puts your music library front and center. It features a clean, minimal design that lets you listen distraction-free.

p.em: Note: Riff requires a Spotify Premium account. Some accounts may not work due to Spotify's new PlayPlay DRM, which is proprietary and cannot be implemented externally.

ul.li: Modern GTK4 and libadwaita interface with light/dark themes and a responsive layout
Play, pause, skip, seek, shuffle, and repeat with gapless playback
Like tracks and follow artists, albums, and playlists
Browse your saved albums, playlists, liked tracks, and followed artists
Search for albums, artists, tracks, and playlists
Share and open Spotify links with your friends using automatic link detection
Fine-tune your sound with a built-in DSP engine featuring a 10-band equalizer, stereo pan, and pitch shift
Advanced desktop integration: media keys (MPRIS), inhibits session suspend while playing, and secure credential storage

description.p: This release fixes a playback issue and adds some polish for Flathub

ul.li: Fixed a playback issue introduced by Spotify on Aug 10, 2026
Updated banner colors on Flathub
Updated application summary on Flathub
Removed Pipewire as an audio backend to improve Flathub's risk rating

description.p: This release focuses on improving the listening experience and navigation of your music library. It includes redesigned pages, a configurable audio engine, improved search, and more.

ul.li: Like Songs: a star button on hover lets you like or unlike tracks in playlists, albums, and the queue.
Follow or unfollow artists, albums, and playlists directly from their pages.
Saved Artists page: browse all your followed artists from the sidebar.
Audio engine with a 10-band equalizer, stereo pan, pitch shift, mono audio, volume curves, and configurable audio formats.
Close window behavior: choose to quit or keep running in the background when closing while music plays.
Playlist context menus: right-click or long-press playlists in the sidebar for quick actions.
Sidebar pagination: all your playlists now load in the sidebar.
Shuffle play button on album, artist, and playlist pages.
Searchable via "Spotify" in desktop app launchers.
Improved logout that clears your session, credentials, and cached state.
Improved search that finds tracks and playlists, and can be scoped to artists only.
Filter an artist's releases by albums, singles, and compilations.
Automatic Spotify link detection for easier sharing.
Filter explicit tracks to exclude them from your listening.
Session management inhibition keeps your computer awake so music is not interrupted.
Redesigned playback bar with better alignment, less clutter, and improved mobile support.
Reorganized sidebar with renamed and reordered entries.
Redesigned Now Playing, Artist, Album, Playlist, and Tracks pages.
Card list rework with adjustable icon sizes, multiple layout styles, and sorting.
Improved login page with a premium-requirement notice and clearer error messaging.
Updated About page with links to Discord and GitHub.
Skeleton loading states while pages load.
Improved mobile layout with a new header widget.
Closer conformance to the Human Interface Guidelines.
Riff now uses your system accent color instead of its default green.
Collapsible side panel to give your library more room.
Fixed a crash when scrolling to change volume via mouse wheel or MPRIS.
Fixed the play button sometimes showing an error when opening albums or playlists.
Fixed pages loading duplicate content when scrolling quickly.
Fixed playback controls getting out of sync when a new track starts.
Fixed a crash when a non-Premium account tried to log in; invalid credentials are no longer saved.
Expired tokens now refresh automatically and requests are retried.
Fixed an index-out-of-bounds crash on partially loaded shuffled playlists.
Fixed long playlist and album titles pushing the play button off-screen.
Fixed inconsistent album cover sizes in the library grid.
Fixed the PipeWire audio backend not working correctly in Flatpak.
Improved keyring reliability on startup with automatic retries.
Librespot sessions are now more stable and self-heal to prevent playback interruptions.
Accounts affected by Spotify's PlayPlay DRM now get a clear notice.

description.p: Disabled features (available in the Experimental Feature Panel):

ul.li: Selection mode for selecting multiple tracks at once.
Device selector for switching playback between Spotify Connect devices.
Create new playlist button in the sidebar.

description.p: Beta feature (opt in via the Experimental Feature Panel):

ul.li: Audio normalisation to automatically adjust tracks to a standard loudness.
Podcasts and audiobooks are not supported.
Creating and managing playlists is not supported.
There is no Home or Suggestions page for discovering new media.
Viewing lyrics for the current track is not supported.
The track list widget has some visual bugs.
Some translations and localizations are missing or incorrect.
Some UI elements load slowly.
There is no default art for missing artist or album images.

description.p: This new maintenance release brings simple but fundamental changes.

ul.li: Playback state is now saved and restored properly.
Minor under-the-hood improvements.
More Russian translations.
